subject: Commit triage refresh and owner lanes
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Commit triage refresh and owner lanes

Hi team,

I ran a quick pass on this week's forecast and attached a refreshed R/Y/G export for StormTech (ST-8742). Quick summary: three line items moved yellow this morning after last week's support call, one remaining red with open procurement gating.

Asks:
- Marissa: update stage + expected close date for the two yellow deals in the sheet (column: "owner_action").
- Karthik: confirm whether we can route any partial capacity to reduce the procurement blocker (I think we can offer a short-term hosted tranche).
- Sean: please re-run the commit math for November and push any adjusted MRR to the forecast.

I kept owner lanes in the sheet: please update by EOD today so finance has a clean snapshot for tomorrow's review.

Attachments: 2026-11-30_ryg_sheet_ST-8742.csv, StormTech_MA-plan_v1.xlsx

Thanks — try to keep notes short, we just need firm owner decisions.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
(attachment: 2026-11-30_ryg_sheet_ST-8742.csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit triage refresh and owner lanes

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:15, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I ran a quick pass on this week's forecast and attached a refreshed R/Y/G export for StormTech (ST-8742).

Thanks Sofia — quick updates inline and I uploaded a brief note to the Drive link: two yellow rows (ST-8742-1, ST-8742-3) updated with new close windows and gating items.

Notes:
- ST-8742-1: moved to "Commit - at risk" (yellow). Customer confirmed budget but procurement legal needs an exec signature; expecting 72h. Owner: Marissa.
- ST-8742-3: yellow due to integration timeline. Owner: Marissa.
- Red item (ST-8742-5): unchanged — procurement declined current T&Cs, needs finance escalation.

Action: I set a short canary plan for ST-8742-1 (two-week hosted tranche) as a mitigation; added details to StormTech_MA-plan_v1.xlsx.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: StormTech_MA-plan_v1.xlsx)

From: Lisa Connors <lisa.connors@stormtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit triage refresh and owner lanes

Thanks Marissa — confirming on our side: procurement has signed off on the two-week hosted tranche for ST-8742-1 and legal will circulate the exec approval memo by Friday 12/3. For ST-8742-5, we still need the revised data retention wording (our security team asked for the tenure clarification).

I'll ask our ops lead to review the updated MA plan and get back by Thursday.

Lisa Connors
CTO, StormTech
lisa.connors@stormtech.com

(Forwarded header preserved)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:52:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commit triage refresh and owner lanes

Thanks for the updates — quick engineering & finance check:

- We can provision a two-week hosted tranche for ST-8742-1 next Tuesday (12/7). I added a note in the Drive doc with the runtime estimate and minimal billing flow.
- For ST-8742-5 (red): we can accept a scoped retention amendment (30 days) pending legal sign-off; Sean, if you can mark a partial MRR for December that assumes the tranche goes live, finance will mark the deal as "recoverable-red" in the next commit.

Next steps:
- Marissa to confirm when exec memo is sent (Lisa said by 12/3).
- Sean to update the commit math and post final numbers to HubSpot record (link included).
- Sofia to summarize the final RYG snapshot after 12/3 and send to finance reviewer (cc: finance@redwood.ai).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
(related link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/8742)
